title: Design System: Pholio Agency Command Center

display.purpose: Page mastheads and hero moments. Sparing.

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headers, primary-button text.

label.purpose: Field labels and metadata keys only — never an eyebrow above a heading.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards needing faint separation from canvas.

shadows.name: overlay-lg
shadows.purpose: Side panels and modals — true overlays.

shadows.name: gold-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved emphasis for selected/celebrated elements; never ambient.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action per view — gold fill, dark ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; color: #141210; background: #C9A55A; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B8956A; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,165,90,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White surface, hairline border — non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; color: #2D2A26; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(26,24,21,0.14); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5F2EE; border-color: rgba(26,24,21,0.22); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,165,90,0.25); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Warm white field with inset shadow and a gold focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1A1815; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(26,24,21,0.12); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(26,24,21,0.04); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A39E99; } .ds-input:hover:not(:focus) { border-color: rgba(26,24,21,0.22); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A55A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,165,90,0.15), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(26,24,21,0.04); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White paper panel on the cream canvas — flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(26,24,21,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(26,24,21,0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(26,24,21,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #1A1815; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #6B6560; }

components.name: Section Masthead
components.description: Editorial serif heading — the agency's printed-catalogue voice.
components.css: .ds-masthead { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #1A1815; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }

components.name: Command Rail Item
components.description: Vertical nav item on the deep ink rail — gold marks active, no count bubbles.
components.html: RosterInbox
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px; background: #141210; border-radius: 12px; width: 200px; } .ds-rail-item { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-rail-item--active { color: #C9A55A; background: rgba(201,165,90,0.1); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(201,165,90,0.5); }

narrative.overview: The agency surface is a luxury casting book rendered as software — warm cream stock, gold-foil detailing, a confident serif masthead — given the density and speed of a modern operations tool. A booker should scan a hundred talent, triage an inbox, and move cards across a casting board without the interface ever raising its voice. Authority comes from typography and restraint, not chrome. It is deliberately a separate design system from the talent dashboard: same material (warm neutrals, one gold, Inter body) but its own serif (Playfair Display), tighter motion, and a working-tool density the talent side never reaches for.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream canvas (#FAF8F5), white panels, a single gold accent used sparingly.
Playfair Display serif for headlines; Inter for everything operational.
Density with composure — many signals, low visual noise.
Soft warm shadows + tonal cream layering for depth; never glass.
Motion is quick and state-conveying (150-200ms), not choreographed.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on ≤10% of any screen. It marks the single most important action or the current selection — its rarity is what makes it read as luxury.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Badge Rule
rules.body: Talent availability and pipeline state are carried by plain text or a single non-badge dot/stripe in a semantic color — never a colored pill badge.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Identity Rule
rules.body: Playfair appears only at the masthead/section-title tier. It is forbidden in buttons, labels, table cells, and data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and lift by tone on hover. A shadow is earned by a state change or by being a literal overlay.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() is permitted only on a full-screen functional scrim. On any card, panel, toolbar, or button it is forbidden.

dos: Do keep the canvas warm cream (#FAF8F5) with white paper panels.
Do reserve gold (#C9A55A) for the single most important action or current selection (≤10% of a screen).
Do use Playfair Display only at masthead/section-title tier; Inter for every control, label, and data cell.
Do convey depth by tonal cream layering first, soft warm shadows second.
Do render talent status as plain text or one non-badge dot/stripe.
Do show match score and talent type as plain inline text on cards.
Do provide prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks and keep :focus-visible gold rings.
donts: Don't place a small uppercase / letter-spaced eyebrow or kicker above any heading.
Don't use status badges encoding available / on booking / inactive.
Don't add New / Beta / Live / AI-powered feature badges or accent-dot-plus-badge combos.
Don't overlay tiny metadata chips in card corners or on photo thumbnails.
Don't use backdrop-filter: blur() on cards, panels, toolbars, or buttons.
Don't attach count-bubble badges to nav items or cards.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't let the surface go cold blue-and-white SaaS admin.
